title: 8.62. Savicāraduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Naavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Nasavicārañca naavicārañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… purejāte āsevane cha …pe… avigate nava.
